book.name: Pathaawal Waalan
book.title: Prabhoe Jiesoe Kriest ke pathaawal waalan ke kaam

content: Aur Saulas sotjies kie: „Thiek hai kie ie aadmie maraai gail.” Iesaai samaadj log ke moesiebat Oe rodj se Jeroesaalem ke samaadj log par bara moesiebat paral. Oesab bahoet sataawal gail aur iedhar oedhar Joedea aur Saamaaria diehaat me bhaag gail. Khaalie Prabhoe ke pathaawal waalan sahar me rahie gail.
Ekaatgo bieswaasie aadmie Stefaanas ke mattie deis. Oelogke bahoet doekh raha okar maut se.
Aur Saulas bahoet kausies kare lagal bieswaasie ke samaadj ke naas kare khaatien. Oe ghar ghar me ghoeske mardaana aur aurat ke pakarke band karwaai deis.
Fielepas ke partjaar Saamaaria sahar me
Djaun bieswaasie log Jeroesaalem me se khaderal gail raha, oelog des bhar me khoes khabar bataawe lagal.
Dekh-bhaal kare waala Fielepas aisane Saamaaria sahar me ailaan kare lagal kie Jiesoe aane waala Kriest hai.
Dher Saamaaria log djab okar partjaar soenies aur dekhies kie oe kaun barka kaam kare hai, tab oesab ek hoike okar baat maane lagal.
Dje ke bhoet sataawat raha, oelog me se bhoet tjiellaaike bhaag gail aur dher langar aur loendj log attjha bhail.
Ohie khaatien Saamaaria diehaat me bahoet khoesiaalie aail.
Siemon djaadoegar
Bakie koetjh dien pahiele ek Siemon naam ke aadmie oe sahar me djaadoe karat raha aur Saamaaria log bahoet atjambho howat raha. Oe apane ke bahoet biesaal samdjhat raha.
Sab nietja aur oetja manai log okare oeppar khoeb dhiaan lagaawat raha. Oesab bolies kie: „Dekh, ie aadmie ‘Parmeswar ke barka saktie’ bolaawal dja hai.”
Oe dien se dher log okare pietjhe tjalat raha. Oesab okar djaadoe se atjambho howat raha.

Bakie djab Fielepas khoes khabar Parmeswar ke raadj aur Jiesoe Kriest ke naam ke biese me partjaar karies, tab dher aurat aur mardaana log Prabhoe Jiesoe me bieswaas kare lagal, aur oesab apane ke dopoe karwaais.
Tab Siemon bhie bieswaas kare lagal aur dopoe ke baad oe Fielepas lage se na gail. Ohoe Prabhoe ke biesaal tjienha aur saktie dekhke ghabaraai gail.
Tab djab Prabhoe ke pathaawal waalan Jeroesaalem me soenies kie Saamaaria ke manai log Parmeswar ke baat apana leis hai, tab oesab Petras aur Johaanas ke hoewa pathaais.
Oelog djab pahoetjal tab praatna karke Saamaaria ke bieswaasie log khaatien Pawietr Aatma maangies.
Oe sahar me to Pawietr Aatma abbe koi ke na mielal raha. Oesab khaalie Prabhoe Jiesoe ke naam me dopoe bhail raha.
Tab djab Petras aur Johaanas bieswaasie log par aapan haath rakhies, tab oelogke Pawietr Aatma mielal.
Tab Siemon ie kaam dekhke maangies oesabke paisa dewe aur bolies kie:
„Hamahoe ke ie saktie dewo kie ham koi ke oeppar haath rakhke Pawietr Aatma dei sakie.”
Tab Petras bolies: „Toke aur tor paisa me aag lage! Ka, toe sotje hai kie toe Parmeswar ke saktie paisa se kien sake hai?
Parmeswar ke aakhie me tor diel safa na hai. Ohie se toe ie sab kaam me bhaag na lei paihe.
Aapan paap-boeraai tjhor de aur Parmeswar se praatna kar kie oe toke tor kharaab sotj-bietjaar khaatien tjhama kar dewe.
Ham to dekhlie kie toe bahoet djarantoeha aur kharaab boeraai me ekdam se djhakaral baate.”
Tab Siemon bolies: „Toelog hamaar khaatien Prabhoe se praatna kar aur ose poetjh kie tor saraap hamaar oeppar na pare.”

Ekare baad djab Johaanas aur Petras Saamaaria sahar me Prabhoe ke baat ke biese me aapan gawaahie deike aur partjaar kar tjoekal raha, tab oesab phien Jeroesaalem laut gail. Aur djaite me oesab Parmeswar ke khoes khabar Saamaaria diehaat ke gaaw me bataawat raha.
Fielepas aur Etiopia des ke mantrie
Tab Parmeswar ke ekgo parie Fielepas se bolies kie: „Sandjha ke apane ke tajaar karke oe rasta par djaihe djaun Jeroesaalem se Gaasa sahar dja hai. Oe rasta bahoet soen-saan hai.”

Fielepas apane ke tajaar karke gail. Djaite me oke ekgo ghora-gaarie bhetaail. Oman ekgo raadj tjalaawe waala aadmie baithal raha. Oe Etiopia des ke Kandaake naam ke raanie ke mantrie raha aur okar paisa ke kaar-baar karat raha. Oe Jeroesaalem gail raha Parmeswar ke poedje khaatien.
Aur ab oe lautke djaat raha. Gaarie me baithke oe Parmeswar ke sanesia Jasaaja ke poestak parhat raha.
Tab Pawietr Aatma Fielepas se bolies: „Gaarie lage dja.”
Oe haalie se gaarie lage gail aur okar bagal tjale lagal. Tab otane me soenies kie mantrie ka parhe hai.
Tab ose poetjhies: „Sriemaan djie, aap samdjhe hai aap ka parhe hai?” Tab mantrie bolies: „Ham kaise samadjh sakab djab koi hamke na samdjhaai? Aaw hamare bagal baith.” Fielepas baithal.
Tab mantrie ie baat parhies kie:

content.text: „Djaise bhera ledjaawal dja hai maar dhaaral khaatien,
Aur djaise bhera ke battja tjoep-tjaap rahe hai djab okar rowa tjhiela hai,
oisane okar moeh me se ekko baat na niekaral.
Okar bahoet bedjatie karal gail aur kaanoen dwaara na faisala bhail.
Ke okar aulaad ke biese me koetjh bataai sakie?
Okar djiewan dhartie par se hataai dewal gail.”

content: Aur mantrie Fielepas se poetjhies kie: „Bataaw to, Jasaaja ie baat kekar biese me liekhies hai? Apane biese me kie doesar koi ke biese me?”
Tab ie liekhal baat kaam me laaike oe soeroe karies Jiesoe ke biese me phor-phorke samdjhaawe ke.
Aisane batiaite oesab paanie lage se paas bhail. Tab mantrie bolies: „Dekh, hoewa paanie hai! Ham dopoe hoi sakiela kie na? Koetjh hamke roke hai?” [
Tab oe bolies: „Djab toe poera diel se Prabhoe Jiesoe me bieswaas kare hai, tab koetjh na toke roke hai.” Tab mantrie bolies: „Ha, ham bieswaas kariela kie Jiesoe Kriest Parmeswar ke Beta hai.”]
Oe gaarie rokwaais aur doeno paanie me gail. Aur Fielepas oke dopoe karies.
Tab djab oesab paanie me se niekaral, tab Pawietr Aatma Fielepas ke hoewa se hataai legail. Mantrie oke phien na dekhies. Oe bahoet khoesiaalie me Etiopia des ke or gail.
Baad me Fielepas Aasdod sahar me dekhaail. Aur hoewa se oe ie sahar se oe sahar me khoes khabar partjaar karte Sesaarea sahar me pahoetjal.
Kaise Prabhoe Jiesoe Saulas se bhet karies
